claim_tested: Are the yeast Oca proteins PFA-DSPs, and are they catalytically active?
key_finding: Oca1/Oca2/Oca4/Oca6 assigned to PFA-DSP group; Siw14/Oca3 active in vitro, Oca1 no detectable activity; Siw14 overexpression suppresses caffeine sensitivity of oca1/2/4/6 deletions
context: S. cerevisiae; recombinant protein assays and deletion-strain growth
confidence: high for family assignment and for the Siw14/Oca1 contrast; Oca6 itself was never assayed

claim_tested: What does an active PFA-DSP active site require?

context: S. cerevisiae Siw14 catalytic core, X-ray + mutagenesis + kinetics
confidence: high; defines the positive reference, not direct evidence about Oca6

context: X-ray 2.35 A, recomputed from deposited coordinates
confidence: high; citrate is an anion mimic, not the physiological substrate

claim_tested: Could any basic residue occupy the CX5R arginine position, or a nearby P-loop position, in some Oca6 ortholog?
key_finding: Basic-residue occupancy at the CX5R Arg position is 0/177 in Oca6 (Val 152, Ile 19, Thr 3, Ser 1, Met 1) vs 120/120 in Siw14 and 114/120 in Oca1 (Fisher p=2.0e-86). At the Siw14 Arg216 position, the 2.26 A citrate contact, Oca6 carries Asp in 128/177 and Asn in 48/177. Summed basic occupancy over the 7 post-Cys positions: Siw14 4.43, Oca1 2.94, Oca6 0.32. Fold positions stay conserved in Oca6: Cys 99.4%, Gly 99.4%, +7 Ser/Thr 84.2%.
context: 417 UniProt members of three CDD subfamily models, ungapped BLOSUM62 anchor on the P-loop core
confidence: Direct computational result. Limitations: CDD membership is not a phylogenetically balanced species sample, ungapped anchoring would miss an indel inside the P-loop, and subfamily assignment is itself model-based.
